name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-exchange-chain-services-section
description: RCE's Semiotic Exchange Chain Services Section: specifies the fusion of public standard protocols -- EAVT/Datom, EVM settlement, ActivityPub/WMAP, A2A, x402, UCAN -- into one exchange chain in which the chain is the only durable home, actuators are ephemeral, and the Semiotic Voxel exists only actively. This section specifies; it does not itself operate a chain.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one boundary of the exchange chain, allocated exactly one public standard, traced to a requirement and owned by exactly one module
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: a second semantic center beside the EAVT source symbol, a persisted Semiotic Voxel, a permanent actuator host, local data presented as a home rather than a cache, an identifier law competing with the chain's own, an unallocated boundary, or this section operating what it specifies
